svg.title: Analog Blend Plugin Signal Flow
svg.desc: Signal flow diagram showing input splitting into dry path, Pultec saturation chain, and SSL saturation chain, with harmonic bleed always active, all summed to output with gain compensation.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the input stage of the plugin')
sendPrompt('Why is a dry path needed in a parallel saturation plugin?')
sendPrompt('How do I implement Pultec-style saturation in HISE?')
sendPrompt('How do I implement SSL-style saturation in HISE?')
sendPrompt('How does the Pultec mix knob work in HISE RoutingMatrix?')
sendPrompt('How does the SSL mix knob work in HISE RoutingMatrix?')
sendPrompt('How do I implement the always-on harmonic bleed in HISE like the SSL 4000?')
sendPrompt('How do I sum parallel chains in HISE and avoid phase issues?')
sendPrompt('How do I implement RMS gain compensation in HISE ScriptProcessor?')
sendPrompt('What is the final output stage of the plugin?')
